name: figdoc
description: Convert Figma design files into structured, editable content documentation.

scripts.deploy:auth: npm run build:auth && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project figdoc-e0f98
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.check: npm run lint -w client && npm run package:plugin && npm run test -w server && npm run build:auth && npm run build -w client
